Looking forward to connecting,

items.title: Speaking Opportunity for a Senior Leader at Accenture
items.summary: BOARD's programme is built for the European CEOs, Chairs, Non Executive Directors and investors in the room, and every session has to earn its place. Speaking opportunities are not sold. We work with partners only where there is genuine alignment: a shared view of the challenges facing Europe's private companies, and a contribution our audience will value, whether that is research, data or the experience of senior leaders.
benefits: Where alignment exists, partners work closely with our content team to shape sessions within the programme.

BOARD retains editorial responsibility for the format, the topic and the participants, so that what reaches the stage is useful to the people in the room. This protects the standard of the forum, and with it the value of being part of it.

BOARD brings together the CEOs, boards and investors shaping Europe's fastest-growing companies for three days in Monaco. These are the leaders making decisions about cloud, AI, data and the technology partners they build their future on — and they're notoriously hard to reach in one place. At BOARD, they're all in the room.

I've highlighted a handful of opportunities I think fit Google's goals particularly well, but the full programme is here for you to explore. Everything can be tailored — from how you show up on stage to the conversations we set up for your team.

I'd love to find a time to talk through what a partnership could look like. Whatever questions you have, I'm on hand.

Warm regards,
